answer.description: Explain or answer without changing repository artifacts or causing external effects.

review.description: Inspect and report findings without changing repository artifacts or causing external effects.

diagnose.description: Determine cause and gather evidence without implementing a fix or causing external effects.

design.description: Produce a decision, specification, or plan without changing repository artifacts or causing external effects.

implement.description: Create or change repository artifacts, verify the result locally, and stop before external or shared-environment effects.

operate.description: Perform a specifically authorized operational, shared-environment, external, or release action without changing repository artifacts; operation-time edits require a separate implement-mode cycle.

project_overlays.name: laravel-react-inertia
project_overlays.description: Optional Laravel, React, Inertia, and TypeScript preferences; active only when explicitly adopted by the project's PROJECT-AGENT-PROFILE.md.

durable_task.description: Any engineering answer, review, diagnosis, design, implementation, or operation governed by this pack.

implementation_task.description: Creation, modification, movement, or deletion of durable repository artifacts.

operational_action.description: A non-repository operational action will change local runtime, shared, or external state under OPERATE.

existing_unfamiliar_code.description: Work in an existing or unfamiliar codebase where behavior, ownership, or local conventions must be discovered before decisions are made.

vague_material_requirement.description: A material requirement, acceptance boundary, policy, or constraint is ambiguous or conflicting.

material_requirement_or_constraint.description: A clear accepted high-stakes, consequential, cross-boundary, or architecturally significant requirement or constraint materially determines correctness, quality, security, privacy, cost, compatibility, or a public contract.

complex_reasoning_or_state_model.description: The task needs explicit invariants, state transitions, multi-step decomposition, competing-constraint analysis, or a non-obvious approach decision.

behavior_change.description: Observable runtime, contract, validation, state, or user behavior changes.

test_logic_or_verification_change.description: Executable tests, fixtures, assertions, test harnesses, or verification logic change without changing production behavior.

pure_refactor.description: Internal structure changes while observable behavior and public contracts are intended to remain unchanged.

bug_or_regression.description: A failing test, defect, regression, or unexpected behavior needs evidence-led diagnosis or correction.

architecture_or_public_boundary.description: A public contract, ownership boundary, shared abstraction, service boundary, or costly-to-reverse architecture decision changes.

new_durable_boundary.description: A new service, module, shared component, durable configuration surface, or long-lived ownership boundary is proposed.

dependency_change.description: A new or materially changed runtime dependency, framework, hosted service, or vendor commitment is proposed.

supply_chain_change.description: A package version, lockfile, package source, build script, CI action, generated artifact, or dependency trust decision changes.

supply_chain_advisory_or_bounded_vulnera.description: A dependency or build advisory, or a bounded vulnerability with no credible active compromise or material security impact, requires intake and assessment.

supply_chain_vulnerability_or_compromise.description: A material supply-chain vulnerability, suspected malicious package or source, or suspected or confirmed compromised build path requires assessment or response.

repository_code_execution.description: Repository-controlled tests, builds, generators, hooks, migrations, installers, or other scripts will execute locally.

unfamiliar_or_privileged_repository_exec.description: Repository-controlled code is unfamiliar, mutation-prone, networked, installer- or hook-driven, or would run with credentials, elevated privileges, broad filesystem access, or material cost.

untrusted_input_or_data_access.description: Code parses untrusted input, constructs a database or search query, resolves an object scope, or exposes a data-access boundary.

established_security_boundary.description: Bounded work touches an established, unchanged authentication, authorization, tenant-isolation, secret-handling, or other security boundary without expanding privilege, data exposure, or trust.

security_sensitive.description: A new, changed, or high-impact authentication, authorization, tenant-isolation, secret-handling, or sensitive trust boundary is involved, or there is a material security vulnerability or credible regulated, bulk, or cross-tenant data exposure.

sensitive_data_handling.description: Personal or sensitive data is handled within an established and approved trust boundary without creating a new high-impact boundary.

privacy_lifecycle.description: Consent, purpose limitation, collection, retention, deletion, subject rights, residency, or material privacy-governance behavior changes.

persisted_data.description: Persisted state, transactions, idempotency, durable identifiers, or stored data behavior changes.

schema_or_migration.description: A schema, index, migration, backfill, or compatibility transition for persisted data changes.

critical_data_integrity.description: A credible failure could corrupt, lose, duplicate, misattribute, or leak material data across an authorization or ownership scope.

algorithmic_efficiency.description: A hot path, query, loop, transform, cache, queue, latency target, or user-sized and growing workload needs complexity or performance analysis.

production_runtime_flow.description: A service, worker, job, webhook, integration, or other production runtime flow changes.

running_system_symptom.description: A symptom in a running system requires telemetry-led investigation.

recurring_or_bounded_operational_failure.description: A recurring or operationally significant but bounded failure needs durable detection, ownership, mitigation, or prevention.

credible_high_impact_harm.description: The task has a credible path to high-impact harm involving human safety, health, rights, employment, finances, privacy, or security, or material system integrity or availability, and no more specific Critical signal already represents the same consequence.

user_interface.description: A user-facing interaction, workflow, accessibility behavior, or visual information hierarchy changes.

user_interface_with_data.description: A form or user interface reads, submits, reveals, or transforms application data.

ai_product_behavior.description: LLM, embedding, retrieval, classifier, agent, model, or tool-using product behavior changes and needs explicit evaluation.

nontrivial_ai_assisted_work.description: AI materially assisted a durable engineering artifact or decision and provenance must be disclosed.

release_design_or_configuration.description: A release strategy, rollback design, deployment configuration, staged rollout, or release control is designed or changed without executing it.

production_readiness_assessment.description: A production-ready, shippable, deployable, or release-readiness claim is evaluated.

shared_environment_release_execution.description: A production deployment, release, promotion, rollout, or a material or difficult-to-recover shared-environment release mutation will actually execute.

artifact_build_or_distribution.description: A release artifact is packaged, signed, attested, promoted, distributed, or published, or its provenance and identity controls change.

configuration_or_feature_flag.description: Runtime configuration, environment-dependent behavior, feature flags, kill switches, or temporary operational controls change.

security_relevant_configuration.description: Configuration materially changes authentication, authorization, secrets, TLS, origin or network trust, security headers, execution permissions, or data-exposure controls.

deprecation_or_replacement.description: An old interface, behavior, data shape, dependency, service, or system will be deprecated, migrated, replaced, or removed.

external_side_effect.description: An action will write to an external service, contact another person, publish content, create a remote resource, or otherwise cause an effect outside the local workspace.

destructive_or_irreversible_action.description: An action materially deletes, overwrites, rotates, revokes, destroys, or makes valuable state difficult to recover; scoped reviewable version-controlled edits with a verified recovery path do not match.

material_public_communication.description: An external communication is legally binding, security- or incident-sensitive, mass-distributed, or materially difficult to retract without reputational or user harm.

bounded_credential_or_permission_action.description: A specifically scoped, reversible credential or permission action is confined to a local or isolated non-production environment and does not expand privilege, transfer ownership, expose sensitive data, or create material downstream impact.

credential_permission_financial_or_legal.description: An action changes production, shared, or privileged credentials or permissions; expands privilege; transfers ownership; commits funds; creates a legal obligation; or signs, approves, or makes one of those consequential decisions on another party's behalf.

production_incident_change.description: A live production incident response will mutate production or a shared environment.

product_domain_discovery.description: User value, business workflow, domain policy, success criteria, or the smallest useful product scope needs discovery.

major_project_uncertainty.description: Material uncertainty spans scope, ownership, feasibility, safety, cost, or reversibility and needs explicit risk reduction.

api_contract.description: A public API, event, webhook, protocol, schema, SDK-facing surface, versioning policy, or compatibility contract changes.

database_design.description: A data model, query shape, index, transaction, isolation, ownership, or database architecture decision changes.

distributed_system.description: Cross-process, cross-service, queue, region, ordering, delivery, consistency, retry, or partition behavior changes.

platform_infrastructure.description: Cloud, infrastructure as code, network, identity, compute, storage, runtime platform, or environment topology changes.

quality_strategy.description: Cross-system test architecture, quality gates, a flaky or slow suite, or release-confidence strategy changes.

active_incident_coordination.description: A high-impact incident needs coordination, containment planning, evidence tracking, communication, and recovery without authorizing live mutation by itself.

cross_team_technical_leadership.description: Multi-person or cross-team prioritization, delegation, ownership, technical review, mentoring, or decision facilitation is needed.

documentation_stewardship.description: A durable README, API guide, architecture record, runbook, migration guide, or documentation-drift decision is needed.

formal_assurance.description: A material invariant, protocol, or algorithm needs property-based, model-based, static, proof-strength, or other formalized evidence.
